MakeMyTrip, founded by Deep Kalra in 2000, is India’s leading online travel platform. Starting with the US-India travel market, it expanded operations in India by 2005. With the rise of low-cost carriers, MakeMyTrip revolutionized travel by offering instant bookings for flights, hotels, and holidays. Over the years, it diversified into homestays, cabs, buses, trains, and launched myBiz for business travel and myPartner for travel agents. Strategic partnerships and entry into the Gulf market have further strengthened its position as a one-stop travel solution.
